content.text:
MailDev
  Version: 3.0.0
  SMTP Server
    Address: ::
    Port:    1025
  Web Interface
    URL:     http://localhost:1080/
  Press Ctrl+C to stop

=== probe routes ===
/ -> 404
/home -> 404
/api/emails -> 404
/emails -> 404
/api/v2/emails -> 404
=== SMTP inside container ===
421 cbbcc729d0f0 You talk too soon

observation.command: docker logs startuphafen-devcontainer-maildev-1 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "=== probe routes ==="; for p in / /home /api/emails /emails /api/v2/emails; do printf "%s -> " "$p"; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:1080$p"; done; echo "=== SMTP inside container ==="; docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer-maildev-1 sh -c 'printf "QUIT\r\n" | timeout 5 bash -c "cat < /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/1025" 2>/dev/null || (echo QUIT | timeout 5 nc 127.0.0.1 1025 2>/dev/null)' 2>&1 | head -3
